chunks: The Banu Umayyah are allowing me the inheritance of Muhammad (S) bit by bit. By Allah, if I live I would throw them away as the butcher removes the dust from the dust-covered piece of flesh.

key_terms.الْوِذَامِ: A piece of meat or flesh
key_terms.بَنُو أُمَيَّةَ: The Banu Umayyah, the Umayyad clan

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the butcher metaphor in the Prophet's statement about the Umayyads?
ai.summary: This narration, often cited in Shia exegesis as a prophecy of Umayyad dominance, highlights the gradual usurpation of the Prophet's spiritual and political legacy. The vivid metaphor of the butcher shaking off dust emphasizes the eventual and decisive expulsion of the Umayyads from power, a theme central to the concept of *Ghadir* and the transition of authority to the Ahl al-Bayt.
